notes:
Summary: SprintFlux is building a low-latency personalization + RTB layer that depends on sub-200ms end-to-end inference for ranking and creative personalization. They are cost-sensitive — high QPS during morning/prime time — and want to aggressively reduce unit cost without sacrificing tail latency. Key ask: help prove out a production setup (Dedicated/VPC) with quantization + caching + batching recommendations and run standardized perf benchmarks they can include in the RFP.

From CTO (Evan Malik): "We can tolerate slight quality delta if we drop cost 30-50% — but p95 must stay <150ms for candidate API calls. Need deterministic tail numbers, not averages."

Technical constraints / requirements: 
- Workloads: reranking of top-100 candidates (batch of 1–16), personalization scoring, and short-turn chat for human-in-the-loop agents.
- Latency targets: p50 ~ <30ms for embedding lookups/ranking calls; p95 <150ms for full rerank (end-to-end).
- Throughput: expect steady 800–1,500 reqs/sec, peaks to 6k rps during events.
- Cost sensitivity: goal to reduce per-1k-token equivalent cost by ~40% via quantization and caching.
- Models: prefer open Llama-family variants or Redwood-verified weights; fallback to larger model for quality-sensitive flows.
- Routing needs: region-aware routing (NA primary, EU failover), model-variant fallback to maintain availability.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown, p95/p99 traces, and per-route dashboards mandatory.
- Security: must run in customer VPC with KMS integration + audit logs; SOC2/ISO27001 required by procurement.

POC & benchmarking ask:
- Redwood to run perf benchmarking requests against a replayed 1-hour production slice (we provided) and produce: p50/p95/p99 tail, CPU/GPU utilization breakdown, batching/cold-cache vs warmed-KV cache numbers, and cost-per-1k-token estimate for each config.
- Evaluate quantization profiles (fp16, int8, 4-bit where applicable) and report quality delta via judging set (we provided ~500 labeled pairs).
- Run a set of automated experiments that vary batch window (0ms, 5ms, 10ms, 25ms), KV cache hit rates (0%, 50%, 80%), and routing to smaller model variants under load to show graceful degradation.

Commercial notes:
- Interested in Dedicated reserved pools for baseline throughput with burst to hosted for spiky events.
- Will need pricing for a committed 12-month Dedicated arrangement plus Optimize advisory bundle.

Stated next steps from AE: finish POC runs by 2025-02-15, deliver perf report + Optimize recommendations, schedule infosec call week of 2025-02-17.
